caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden wardrobe with two doors and a single drawer at the bottom. The wardrobe is primarily brown, with darker brown outlines accentuating the panels and edges. Each door features two rectangular panels, making a total of four panels, each containing a cluster of painted flowers in various colors such as red, yellow, green, and blue, surrounded by black ornamental scrollwork at the corners. The top of the wardrobe has a stepped, triangular pediment with additional black scrollwork detail in the center and along the edge. The drawer at the bottom has two round knobs and a central floral cluster matching the door panels. The base of the wardrobe is shaped with a scalloped apron. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Painted Wardrobe
